name: Carbuncle
overview: The carbuncle is identified in Scripture as a precious stone, notably included among the stones set in the high priest's breastplate, symbolizing holiness and divine beauty (Exodus 28:17; 39:10). It is also described as a gem used in God's promises of restoration and protection, such as the gates of the New Jerusalem being made of carbuncles, signifying strength and glory (Isaiah 54:12). Furthermore, the carbuncle is listed among the precious stones covering the cherub in Eden, highlighting its association with God's original creation and splendor (Ezekiel 28:13).
